DeterminationBasis: Existing T05 controls address evidence class, provenance, authentication, integrity, test-evidence structure, stable identity, re-hashability and trust-boundary identification, but no existing T05 control requires a cryptographic signature to identify the key, certificate, trust anchor or equivalent verification basis needed to verify that signature. A distinct cryptographic signature verification-basis test is therefore required.

T03-003 explicitly falsifies substitution of technical capability, credentials or access for governance authority. It requires technical capability not to establish governance authority and fails if possession of access or capability alone authorises consequential execution. This directly covers the SEC-007 prohibition on automatically treating access-control permission as governance authority.
